thread:
Sam: Partner 'EdgeWave' raised a billing anomaly: several customers show duplicate "heartbeat" usage for the same hour, doubling billed device-minutes. Ticket: https://edgewave.help/TKT-221
Rin: do they send device_ts or server_received_ts?
Sam: device_ts, and some devices have flaky RTC. when a device reboots it emits past timestamps and our hour bucketing accepts them, causing duplicate counts.
Omar: rough fix: always bucket by server_received_ts by default, but keep an opt-in to use device_ts for partners that guarantee clock sync.
Rin: agree. migration plan: 1) detect out-of-order device_ts where device_ts < received_at - 1h and flag as 'device_clock_skew'. 2) when flagged, ignore device_ts for bucketing and use received_at instead. Emit partner alert and surface in partner-ops dashboard.
Sam: billing-bot, how many customers affected in last 30 days?
billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner='edgewave' AND date >= '2026-02-10' AND duplicate_heartbeat_flag = true; estimated rows: 76
Omar: for historicals we should not auto-adjust invoices. propose: mark suspicious windows as 'review_pending' and surface top 20 impacted customers for manual reconciliation credits.
Rin: Partner ops note: ask EdgeWave to include monotonic sequence numbers in heartbeat payload (seq_no) so we can dedupe across reboots.
Sam: security/ops: replays must be HMAC signed. If partner adds seq_no we can accept replays for 14 days to repair missing originals.
Omar: I'll add a quick feature-flagged rollout for server-bucket-first logic and a dashboard card. Rin please draft partner comms requesting seq_no + clock-sync recommendation.
ops-bot: automated: feature-flag created partnerships.hotfix.edgewave_server_bucket; canary rollout scheduled in 2 hours. Alert rule: if duplicate_heartbeat_rate > 0.8% trigger P1.
Rin: thanks—I'll also include example payloads and the replay contract in the comms. Sam: add this to Monday partnership review.
